Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.select

Class Select

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.composite.select.Select
@Component public class Select extends Object
A custom composite Action that performs selection operations through swiping.

Select demonstrates how to build custom Actions using SelectActionObject. It implements a common UI automation pattern: swiping through a scrollable region until finding target images, clicking on them, and optionally verifying success through confirmation images.

The operation flow is:

  1. Search for target images in the current view
  2. If found, click on them
  3. If confirmation images are specified, verify they appear
  4. If not found, swipe and repeat up to maxSwipes times

This class serves as an example of how to create custom composite Actions. ActionObjects like SelectActionObject contain both ActionConfig and ObjectCollection instances, providing all configuration needed for the operation. The Action class (Select) implements the logic for how and when these configurations are used.

  • Method Details

    • select

      public boolean select(SelectActionObject sao)
      Executes the selection operation defined by the provided SelectActionObject.

      This method implements the core selection logic: repeatedly searching for target images and swiping if not found. When images are found, it clicks on them and optionally verifies success through confirmation images. The method modifies the state of the provided SelectActionObject to track results.

      Side effects on the SelectActionObject parameter:

      • Resets and updates the total swipe count
      • Sets found matches from each find operation
      • Sets confirmation matches if confirmation is required
      • Updates the success status based on the operation outcome
      Parameters:
      sao - The SelectActionObject containing all configuration and state for the operation. This object is mutated during execution to store results.
      Returns:
      true if the operation succeeded (target found and clicked, with optional confirmation verified), false if max swipes reached without success
